data.long_meaning: Ettika is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Ettam' which means 'eternal'. The suffix 'ka' is added to denote the feminine gender. Ettika is the goddess of righteousness and virtue, revered in Hindu mythology. The name Ettika carries the meaning “Goddess of righteousness” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Ettika usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of righteousness and live with faith, good character and purpose.
